notes.title: The Keys of Fate - Alternate Final Boss (v.1.6.0)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887888/735a41e0f3091dd2287829446c07c7e73e2dfa4d.png[/img]

[b]Hey all![/b]
This final content update brings a brand new final boss. The new boss is the original entity which was corrupted, leading to the events seen in the game. This also acts as a teaser for the prequel now in development, as this boss is the protagonist. I am now ready to reveal the title of the new game will be [b]"[i]Primarch[/i]"[/b], releasing some time in 2022.

Victor of a planet wide gauntlet, the Primarch absorbed the abilities of all it defeated. The Primarch toggles between 5 sets of abilities (6 on C20). I recommend a slightly more aggressive party than you would build for the regular final boss - bringing too much healing in place of damage will cause the Primarch to eventually scale out of control. Feel free to unleash your Whirlwind Axes and Symbiotes, this boss does not remove buffs.

In order to battle the new boss, you must collect 3 "key items" during a run. The location of each of these items can be seen in the Item Library, however they are very easy to naturally discover as well. You only get one opportunity to take each key in a run, so be certain when leaving them behind - they do not reappear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887888/a0e20afb7d62476f0284618e611b6e6d11d39af5.png[/img]

Once all 3 keys are obtained, they combine in to an item which causes the new final boss to spawn in place of the normal one. You can also choose to instead sell this item for a hefty sum, making it a viable strategy to create the item exclusively for the gold return. 

While this is the final content update, I will now be looking in to the feasibility of translations as I have mentioned previously. I want to give a massive thank you to everyone who has supported Astronarch, it's thanks to you I was able to continue free updates coming for these past 5 months. I hope to entertain you all once again with the release of "Primarch" next year.

~ Dale

notes.title: Omens - New Difficulties, Features, Events (v.1.5.0)
notes.content:
Hey all!
New this update are Omen difficulties. These are optional modifiers you can toggle on or off, and can be used with or without Corruption activated. They are essentially super Corruptions, with each of them being far more impactful than any single Corruption effect. There are 4 in total, which are unlocked as you progress Corruption levels. They provide an experience bonus when activated, and each have a new achievement associated with beating them in a certain way.

This major update also brings a rework to Corruption 20, new map events, and balance changes. There are still lots of requested features I want to add before shifting development to the sequel, and I will also be looking at the possibility of translations soon. Thanks for the support as always.
~ Dale

notes.content:
Hey all!
About a month ago I mentioned that with the success of the game I was going to commission a composer to make us a custom soundtrack. This was only possible thanks to all of you who bought the game and shared news of it with friends. Also a big thanks to the content creators, who can now be assured they won't randomly trigger a claim on Youtube due to shared music rights.

A performance overhaul is planned for the next patch, which will reduce the resources needed to run the game by up to 4x. Thank you to those who have been patiently waiting.

notes.content:
Hey folks,

This update adds new unlocks associated with hero levels, which is a feature you get after beating the game once. The progress towards your next unlock is visible in the tavern. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887888/b9b6ab8b634ce89ddb420aaeae273b56d993e309.jpg[/img]

If you already have 55 or more hero levels, all of the new items and the new hero will be instantly available. A feature to start a new game file will be added soon for those who want to start over without losing their current progress.

There are 30 new items, most of which were inspired from fan submissions. These new items seek to fill gaps in current hero builds, and also create many new ones. The other goal of this update was to introduce a little more progression and variety while you are climbing the corruption levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36887888/8b76fbbb7b83ddf93da16e8946bc0792e41689ca.jpg[/img]

There is also a new hero, unlocked after achieving 25 hero levels. The Fallen wields very different effects depending on where your other heroes are positioned. The Fallen will intercept some incoming damage for adjacent allies (triggering items like Bone-Spike Armor), but will also slowly steal health from allies not adjacent. This passive healing ability allows the Fallen to tank without a dedicated healer, and instead rewards self/AoE healing for your other party members. The Fallen's active ability works in a similar way, but I'll keep some mystery for those yet to unlock him.

notes.title: Frost & Item Changes (v.1.3.3)
notes.content:
[h1]Patch 1.3.3[/h1]
A substantial change this patch is changing the max Frost stacks from 5 to 10. This is to allow effects based on Frost to scale more gradually over combat. Several Frost items and abilities have been adjusted due to this change. 

The debuff at max stacks is staying the same, Frost is not now twice as effective. While setting the max stacks at 5 made sense in the initial iterations of the game, it became too easy a cap to hit later on. Having a higher number of stacks also makes it a much easier effect to design items around.

With this change, the Frostmancer won't have such an easy time obliterating groups of enemies. There are no changes to how the Frostmancer works overall, it will just require a little more investment to pull off. A mechanic with the Frostmancer I'll point out which isn't too clear - their active ability applies Frost from their passive BEFORE calculating damage and stun duration. This means a fully upgraded Frostmancer can still reap havoc with no support whatsoever, splashing Frost between enemies for many additional Frost stacks.

General Changes:
[list]
[*] Frost can now stack 10 times, and has had its effect per stack halved.
[*] The end of game victory window has been shifted so the heroes aren't covered.
[*] The Puzzling Box Act 3 event has had its Morale cost reduced, and has a 3x higher chance of giving the item exclusive to the event.
[*] Added a particle effect when MP is stolen (Witch Stick).
[/list]
Frost Related Changes:
[list]
[*] Frostmancer passive ability - Applying Frost is now guaranteed.
[*] Frostmancer active ability - Additional damage per Frost has been reduced 40% and Stun per stack has been reduced 50%.
[*] [u]Bottled Blizzard[/u] (potion) - Now applies 5 Frost instead of 3 (10 with the stronger potions blessing).
[*] [u]Fenrir's Bane[/u] (common) - Now applies [b]2/3/4[/b] Frost instead of 1/2/3.
[*] [u]Sleetstone Sabre[/u] (common) - Your Attacks have a 30%/60%/90% chance to apply Frost to your target [b]>[/b] Your Attacks have a [b]50%[/b] chance to both apply Frost [b]and deal 3/6/9 Piercing damage for each stack of Frost on your target[/b].
[*] [u]Tundra Talisman[/u] (rare) - Apply 1/2/3 Frost to a random enemy every 2 seconds [b]>[/b] Apply 1/2/3 Frost to [b]all enemies[/b] every [b]3[/b] seconds.
[*] [u]Frozen Shell[/u] (rare) - 10/20/30 DEF > [b]15/30/45[/b] DEF.
[*] [u]Frozen Shell[/u] (rare) - Increase your Defense by 3/6/9 for every active stack of Frost [b]>[/b] Increase your Defense by [b]1/2/3[/b] for every active stack of Frost.
[*] [u]Avalanche[/u] (ancient) - Your Attacks remove a stack of Frost from your target. If successful, you deal 50%/100%/150% Attack Damage to your target and any adjacent enemies [b]>[/b] When you Attack, if your target has 10 Frost, remove all Frost and deal [b]350%/700%/1050%[/b] Attack Damage to your target and any adjacent enemies.
[/list]
Item Changes:
[list]
[*] [u]Bandit Hood[/u] (rare) - Your Attacks have a 4%/8%/12% chance to find 1 Gold [b]>[/b] Your Attacks have a [b]5%/10%/15%[/b] chance to find 1 Gold.
[*] [u]Bandit Hood[/u] (rare) - Now has a sound effect when it activates.
[*] [u]Forgotten Idol[/u] (rare) - Now always hits your target. Now has a passive 10/20/30 Starting MP.
[*] [u]Book of the First[/u] (rare) - Every 5/4/3 times you Attack, gain 1 Negate [b]>[/b] Every 5/4/3 times you Attack, [b]you and a random adjacent ally gain Negate[/b].
[*] [u]Book of the First[/u] (rare) - No longer gives a passive SPD bonus.
[*] [u]Seed Relic[/u] (event) - Now applies Poison at the start of combat and every 5 seconds, instead of every 3 seconds.

[*] Fixed Helm of the Mad King not adding its new values from a past patch.
[*] Fixed a rare bug where the Hydra would be defeated before every head was gone.
[/list]

notes.title: New Hero Unlock Methods & Much More (v.1.2.0)
notes.content:
Hey all,

I've heard your feedback that progression in the game can become stale when failing multiple runs in a row. While at it's core, the main progression in all roguelikes is the collection of game knowledge, I do wholeheartedly agree the additional heroes should be introduced to the player sooner than they are currently.

I've added an additional way to unlock each hero. The tasks can be seen by hovering over the locked hero, and don't require you to be victorious in the run to complete. These tasks have also been added as achievements. They can still be completed if you already have the heroes unlocked. 

The new achievements won't appear in the tavern challenges (they may be added later), so you will need to refer to the achievement list in the Steam application in future.

[h1]Patch 1.2.0[/h1]
New hero unlock methods:
[list]
[*] Alchemist - Use 3 potions in one combat.
[*] Outlaw - Defeat an act without visiting a merchant.
[*] Brawler - Emerge victorious in 10 combats during a single act.
[*] Druid - Sell 10 items or potions to the same merchant and then defeat the act.
[*] Bard - Defeat all 3 elites during a single act.
[*] Bloodmage - Sell an ability orb and 2 potions to the same merchant.
[*] Ranger - Defeat an act after visiting at least 7 events.
[*] Fiend - Defeat a boss with 1 hero remaining.
[*] Illusionist - Equip 3 of the same item to a hero.
[/list]

General Changes:
[list]
[*] When unlocking a new corruption, it will automatically be selected the next time you see the tavern.
[*] Water of Life (potion) will no longer activate without a knocked out hero, and readying the potion will cause it to activate as soon as a hero is knocked out without them being untargeted by enemies. This item also now grants you back the morale for the knocked out hero (if it's not the fiend).
[/list]

Hero Changes:
[list]
[*] Heroes now snap to tiles when being moved much more easily and consistently.
[*] The Gladiator's active ability cost - 68 > [b]64[/b].
[*] The Gladiator's active ability - Double damage when target is at or below 25% Max HP > [b]35%[/b] Max HP.
[*] The Warlock's active ability no longer requires adjacency to heal allies, but can only heal 1 ally until upgraded.
[/list]

Item Changes:
[list]
[u]Buffs[/u]
[*] Forgotten Idol has changed from ancient to rare, now gives 50 HP, and is no longer unique.
[*] Odd Bean (ancient) - Instead of being knocked out, heal 25%/50%/75% Max HP and remove all negative effects > [b]30%/60%/90%[/b] Max HP.
[*] Crown of the Banshee (ancient) - When you are knocked out, you continue fighting for 4/8/12 seconds > [b]5/10/15[/b] seconds.
[*] Helm of the Mad King (ancient) - Attackers increase your Attack by 3/6/9 and Speed by 3%/6%/9% > [b]4/8/12[/b] Attack and [b]4%/8%/12%[/b] Speed.
[*] Reverberating Bulwark (ancient) - Attackers deal 15%/30%/45% Attack Damage to themselves > [b]30%/60%/90%[/b].
[*] Life-giving Chamber now grants Protected Max HP instead of Shield.

[u]Nerfs[/u]
[*] Witch Stick has changed from common to rare and is now unique.
[*] Lover's Safeguard has changed from common to rare, is now unique, and requires 1 or less adjacent allies to work. It now gives [b]12/24/36[/b] Shield per second instead of 10/20/30.
[*] Yuki's Hurricane (ancient) - Duration 6/7/8 seconds > [b]5/6/7[/b] seconds.
[/list]

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug causing tooltips to disappear when heroes and enemies attack.
[*] Fixed a rare crash caused by Feral Witchdoctor and Bat Eye.
[*] Heroes were harder to drop on tiles in the tavern.
[*] Grammar fixes.
[/list]

I couldn't resist also sharing this awesome fan art of the Warlock from Damon, the first piece of fan art I've ever received!
~ Dale

notes.title: Item Library, Autosaves, and Steam Cloud (Early Access v.1.2.0)
notes.content:
Hey all,

The final features update before Act 2 is now live. I didn't want this update to be boring, so I'm adding a previously unannounced feature: The Item Library!

[h2]The Item Library[/h2]
Any items you see while playing are now discovered in the Item Library; accessible from the start menu, or from the menu cog while playing. This gives you a collection to complete, as well as a reference for strategizing. 

[h2]Autosaving[/h2]
The game will now autosave, allowing you to close the game mid run and not lose your progress.

[h2]Steam Cloud Support[/h2]
Since this update was all about saving progress, it made perfect sense to also take the time to add Steam Cloud support! Your game data will now sync to the Steam Cloud.

[h2]Crash Logs[/h2]
Kinda boring, I know, but game crash errors are now saved in a text file, and the crash window will give more helpful info to you than before (not that players get crashes often!).

[h2]So...[/h2]
This update took a bit longer than I planned, turns out saving game data is complex (who knew?). If anyone encounters any errors, please don't hesitate to post on the discussion board, or you can join my Discord here: https://discord.gg/5cBSPKk and post in the Astronarch Feedback channel.

With all the feature updates out of the way, we can go full steam ahead with content updates! I have a lot of Act 2 planned out, but art has yet to be started. I'm still steadfast on my goal of Act 2 releasing in June. I'll remind everyone again that the price of the game will be increasing slightly on the release of Act 2, but obviously won't affect anyone who owns the game already.

Thanks everyone for the support and feedback, I'll make sure Act 2 and onwards are worth the wait!
~ Dale.

The Oracle will now greet you at the beginning of your journey to offer some wisdom and a powerful blessing. The blessing you select from the Oracle will vastly change the performance of your party. Potions are prepared, or activated at any time during combat, with a right click. Preparing a potion will have it activate as soon as combat starts. The potion must be in one of your 3 potion slots in order to be used. Excess potions can be stored in your bag.
